said.q: In Performance with “Inside/Outside,” Nengudi is seen from the back, her head comfortably wedged within the tube formed by her nylon mesh, sand, rubber, and foam sculpture. Nengudi has regularly performed with the sculptures in her studio—both for the camera and for an audience—in the process of testing the capacity of her preferred material, pantyhose, which she bends, stretches, and extends beyond the parameters of the human body into constructed yet precarious forms.

events.q: *Inside/Outside* was exhibited in her 1977 solo show at Just Above Midtown gallery—the first in New York to consistently feature African American artists
